name: feature-highlights

frames.best_why: The first card is hovered, showing the lighter fill and pink Learn more while all copy stays sharp.

tagline: Three outlined cards with pink icons lift on hover.
summary: A black highlights block with a pink eyebrow, a big white question as the heading, and three bordered cards each with an icon, blurb and a Learn more link.
appearance: A black field of three equal dark cards with thin grey outlines, rounded corners and generous padding. Each opens with a small pink outlined icon, then a bold white title, grey body copy and a pale Learn more link with an arrow.
behaviour: Hovering a card lightens its fill from near-black to dark grey and turns its Learn more link pink along with the arrow. Nothing else moves.
demo_content: Heading 'Why Toast only?' with cards Pixel Perfect Layout, Editable Components and Scalable Library.
search_phrases: three dark cards with pink icons
card links that turn pink on hover
black page with outlined feature boxes
small pink uppercase label above heading
use_when: A dark page needs three equal benefit cards with short blurbs and a link each.
avoid_when: Three cards are hardcoded, and the long blurbs make cards taller than one screenful.
customise: Card icons, titles and copy come from the darkFeatures array; hover colours and padding are class names.
weight_why: Three static cards with colour transitions on hover.

a11y.note: Learn more buttons have no visible focus ring and the icons are unlabelled; the pink cue rides on hover alone.

issues: The hover treatment is invisible on touch screens.
Card copy is fixed in the source, and 'Why Toast only?' means nothing without context.
polish_why: Tidy, consistent cards; plain beyond the pink accent and lacking motion beyond hover.
